question: X alone can complete a work in 20 days and Y alone can complete the same work in 50 days. They start the work together but after 5 days X leaves the work. How much time will Y take to finish the remaining work?
solution:
**Given:**

X alone can complete the work in 20 days.

Y alone can complete the work in 50 days.

They work together for 5 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work done by X in 1 day = 1/20

Work done by Y in 1 day = 1/50

Total work done by X and Y in 1 day = (1/20) + (1/50)

Remaining work after 5 days = Total work - Work done in 5 days

Time taken by Y to finish remaining work = Remaining work / Work done by Y in 1 day

Work done by X in 1 day = 1/20
